changelog: v1.0.0: 6-gate pre-release checklist, 24h cooldown, self-contradiction detection, release log, weekly review
summary: Enforce release discipline for AI agents and developers. Prevents version spam, forces quality checks before publishing, and maintains a 24-hour cooldown between releases. Use when the user wants to publish, release, deploy, or bump versions. Triggers on "release", "publish", "deploy", "version bump", "npm publish", "릴리즈", "배포", "버전".
